types.name: Fenrir::RawEventRange
types.doc: What one type-erased read through a cursor yields (IEventQueue::ReadRawAfter): the events sent since the previous read, oldest first, as up to two arrays of EventSize()-byte elements in the queue's buffers (nothing is copied). Valid until the queue is next sent to or swapped. The byte form of EventRange.

fields.name: missed
fields.doc: How many events were dropped before the reader got to them (it went two swaps without reading).
